label: agent
scenario: Furniture retailer's AI assistant looks up an order and states delivery window, signature rule, and service level.
task: Confirm the delivery window for Samuel Okafor's sofa order OA33918.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thanks for calling Oak and Arbor Furniture. I'm an automated assistant powered by AI. I can check order status, delivery windows, and returns. what can I help with?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Samuel Okafor. I'd like to confirm the delivery window for his sofa order, number O A 3 3 9 1 8.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thanks. let me look up order O A 3 3 9 1 8.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I found it. Samuel's order, a three seat sofa in slate gray, is scheduled for delivery on Thursday, September seventeenth, between one and five PM. the driver will call about thirty minutes before arrival.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: does someone need to be home to sign?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: yes, an adult will need to be present to sign for the delivery. if no one is home, the delivery will be rescheduled and a redelivery fee may apply.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: yes, this order includes white glove delivery, which covers in home placement and removal of packaging.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: you're welcome. have a great day.
